# dagsterplus_custom_metric (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ custom metric by metadata key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_custom_metric" "my_metric" {
  metadata_key = "asset_runtime_seconds"
}

output "custom_metric_id" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_custom_metric.my_metric.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata_key` (String) The metadata key of the custom metric to look up.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the custom metric was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the metric.
- `display_name` (String) The human-readable display name for the metric.
- `id` (String) The custom metric ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `update_timestamp` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the custom metric was last updated.
